description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmployeeLicenseSearchFilterParams' that extends 'FilterParams'. The class is used to represent search filter parameters related to employee licenses in the OrangeHRM system, including setting and retrieving an employee number and specifying sort fields.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object class for encapsulating filter parameters related to employee licenses, including sorting and employee number filtering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field 'el.licenseIssuedDate'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter. Note: The return type declared as int but the property is nullable string, indicating a potential inconsistency.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter with an integer value.
